limitations: This is a research-local executable showcase, not a public mapping format, stable API, or wire contract.
All fixture source members are anchored at bootstrap. The stages admit pre-provisioned bytes and do not observe live source arrival.
Each change binds its full fixture bundle. Mapping receipts identify selected rows but do not claim per-record or per-operation causality.
The fixture-specific Python mapper is not a general population compiler or mapping language.
Ledger-only replay reloads retained compiled artifacts. It does not recompile raw ontology dependencies without their compiler implementation.
Query answers are not bound to an independently identified query program or projection closure.
The settlement mapping supports exactly one declared two-invoice case. Generic fan-out is not claimed.
The five stages follow a frozen test ladder rather than business-event chronology; the invoice base marker is fixture orchestration, not source time.
No Cypher adapter, arbitrary transaction-prefix query, scoring, evaluator, Event projection, Semantic Re-entry, external effect, public package surface, or cross-language conformance is claimed.
The private runner still contains substantial protocol ceremony. A narrower consumer helper remains future work and is not inferred from this milestone.
